detail: The reported figure of 30,000 is affected people, not demonstrators. No attendee count is provided.

topic: June 19 farmers attendance and domestic-state target
detail: Actual tractor procession is body-verified, but no turnout estimate is given; policy is EU-level although Cyprus officials were asked to intervene.

topic: June 27 fuel dealers count provenance and state target
detail: KNEWS gives >100, attributed to association president; Cyprus Mail independently confirms the blockade/march but no count. It remains an organizer estimate, and the protest also concerns private-market competition.
